## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), where she formed a close friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md). As spring arrived, she and her friends discussed their upcoming final examinations and commencement while preparing for the end of the academic year.
